title: Owner: re-subscribe the phone once and read the push line
goal: The push line counts the one paired phone, and the leftover is gone
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the lifecycle update, on the iPhone open NERV from the Home Screen, Settings → Notifications: Turn off, then Enable notifications and allow them. Then on the Mac run `nerv open dashboard` and open Health. Expected: Phone push reads `1 device`, followed by `· 1 unpaired subscription` only while Safari on the Mac still has notifications on (turn them off there in Settings → Notifications if you do not want them on the Mac: the line then reads `1 device` alone); the base card's push line reads the same; Settings → Paired devices lists one device
privacy: No endpoints or device ids go into Git; the owner reports the line's text only.
validation: Owner check, recorded in B-183 Verification
escalation: The owner decides; the agent records the result

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27: one toggle on the phone, one look on the Mac. Not a measurement.
